definitions: An individual or system that possesses the ability to perform tasks or functions across multiple distinct capabilities or domains.
A user who can effectively operate and contribute within various specialized areas, demonstrating versatility and adaptability.
examples: The new hire is a true Cross Capability User, able to manage both design and development tasks.
Our goal is to train every team member to become a Cross Capability User.
Identifying a Cross Capability User for the project was crucial for its success.
